---
title: "Disparities in the Criminal Justice System"
---

I am currently working with [Dr Matt Ashby](https://lesscrime.info/) and Bedfordshire Police in a project exploring the presence and causes of disparities in stop and search decisions across Bedfordshire. Together with [Dr Sam Lewis](https://essl.leeds.ac.uk/law/staff/204/dr-sam-lewis), I am also updating the report on disparities in charge decisions that we carried out for the CPS in 2022, but was never published.
